title: GTP'(gtpprime): Several visual improvements
description:
1. GTP' protocol does not use order, so when option "Compare GTP order
   with ETSI" is enabled then warning info is added to tree. Exclude
   GTP' messages to check order.
2. Change display type for three IE: "Sequence number released",
   "Sequence number cancelled" and "Requests responded".
3. Add support to match request/response.

Examples of various GTP' packets
[gtpprime_test_packets.pcap](/uploads/8c8b7972865789626befa241cd375562/gtpprime_test_packets.pcap)

About capture file: I tried to simulate different cases.
1. Frames 1, 2: Successfull match request/response
2. Frame 3: Request without response
3. Frame 4: Response without request
4. Frames 5, 6: Successfull match request/response. Multiple CDR records in one request

GTP' IE shall actually be in order, see
```
TS 32.295 6.1.2	Information Elements (IEs)
The messages may contain several Information Elements (IEs). The TLV (Type, Length, Value) or TV (Type, Value) encoding formats shall be used for the GTP' IEs.
The GTP' messages shall have the IEs sorted with the Type fields in ascending order.
```
I miessed this point and will think about it.

Do you mean add comments in code or comment it here?

Unlike GTP, sequence number inside GTP' header of response is not used to confirm request. Insted of this "Data Record Transfer Response" message includes IE "Requests Responded" with sequence numbers of requests to confirm.
GTP dissector does not check that "Requests Responded" can belong only "Data Record Transfer Response" and can belong to any message
But I guess in real network (for simplicity), only "Data Record Transfer Response" can contains "Requests Responded". That is why I hard coded type of message `GTP_MSG_DATA_TRANSF_RESP`.
```
gcrp = gtp_match_response(tvb, pinfo, tree, request_responded_seq_no, GTP_MSG_DATA_TRANSF_RESP, args->gtp_info, cause_aux);
```

A comment in the code please, for further reference as this is a special case for GTP' Data Record. If some else wonder why we do like this.

commits_data.message:
GTP'(gtpprime): Several visual improvements

1. Fixed GTP' check IE order when "Compare GTP order with ETSI"
   is enabled and GTP' version is v2. Check order v1 and v2 the
   same way as v0.
2. Change display type for three IE: "Sequence number released",
   "Sequence number cancelled" and "Requests responded".
3. Add support to match request/response for GTP' specific
   messages: Data Record Transfer Request/Response.
